verdict.rationale: Inngest publishes a dedicated REST API documentation site that lets users work programmatically with events, function runs, environments and more, so the product can be driven through a documented public API. The OpenAPI probe 404s were only on www.inngest.com paths, not the separate api-docs domain, so they do not contradict the claim. missing for 10: detailed evidence of endpoint coverage and authentication, a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Inngest REST API lets you interact with events, function runs, environments, and more programmatically.
